text: First of all, the only ads i have seen in this app is 5 seconds skippable or LESS - this is an amazing thing i haven't seen anywhere else for a long time. The app also helped me get back on track with my smaller daily and weekly tasks, which none of the others have managed for longer periods (more than a week), most likely because the adds haven't chased me away. There are some smaller bugs which i would say are related to my wifi, so no -points there, otherwise it is really easy to use well
